acceptance_predicates.description: In the dev channel, scoped trusted-tool ownership/mode/path findings, SHA-256 mismatches, exact version or toolchain mismatches, and development trust-contract findings emit typed warnings and never fail a command solely for that mismatch.
Every downgraded finding is visible at warning log level and above under the existing log-level contract, in human output, and as a redacted diagnostic in --json.
Supported development commands continue through their normal best-effort result or partial-result path after each scoped mismatch, including asb tui install.
A development trust-contract warning does not stop the installed asb tui install flow and the result truthfully records degraded trust.

Stable and production channels retain strict trust failures; malformed invocation, unsafe path construction or traversal, secret exposure, and impossible filesystem or process states remain hard failures.
A call-site audit and regression coverage demonstrate that no scoped development trust validator remains an unintentional hard failure.

definition_of_done: A signed DCO implementation is independently reviewed and merged on protected ASB main.
Focused and full applicable locked gates pass on the exact reviewed head.
Post-merge development-channel TUI install and command-continuation receipts pass while stable and production negative fixtures remain strict and diagnostics contain no secrets.

inputs.description: Current ASB trusted-tool, digest, version, bundle, catalog, workload, acquisition, and TUI install validators.
Current ASB human output, warning log-level, JSON, redaction, and exit-code contracts.
Development versus stable and production channel policy and selection behavior.

outputs.description: One channel-aware policy for scoped trust mismatches and non-bypassable structural safety failures.
Development command and TUI install best-effort continuation with truthful degraded-trust diagnostics.
Contract, privacy, log-level, JSON, continuation, and strict-channel regression tests.

gates.description: All scoped validators and call sites are inventoried and covered by the channel-aware policy.
Development mismatches warn at warning level and above and command or TUI execution continues.
Stable/production and non-negotiable parser, filesystem, process, and secret boundaries remain hard failures.
Independent review, exact-head CI, signed exact-tree integration, post-merge assurance, and exact-main checks pass.
